_comment: RULE 11: the single source of truth. No literal number, path, port, timeout, limit or label may appear anywhere else. Python reads this via app/constants.py, the UI imports it via ui/src/constants.ts.

app.name: Kanaban Mind
app.tagline: Your Kanban, as a mind map

statuses._comment: A registry: add a status here plus its q-<id> colour in themes.json, nothing else. counts_as: null = not a task (ideas), 'open' or 'done' for progress.

edges._comment: When you drag one node onto another: 'auto' makes a branch if the target has no parent yet (it joins the tree) and a link otherwise; the edge toolbar flips it either way.

branch.label: Branch
branch.hint: Parent → child. Counts toward progress and Tidy.

needs.label: Needs
needs.hint: A dependency: the arrow's end waits for its start.

spacing._comment: How far apart nodes sit: a factor on the gaps between levels and between siblings (2D), and on connection length (3D).

kanban_import.done_elsewhere_note: Marked done in the Kanban on {date}.

cone.label: Cone tree
cone.hint: Each branch opens its own cone. The same shape every time.

organic.label: Organic
organic.hint: Free forces: the map finds its own shape.

radial.label: Radial
radial.hint: Rings around the centre, one per level.

sequence.label: Sequence
sequence.hint: Along the depth axis by how many steps away a task is (needs).

sphere.label: Sphere
sphere.hint: Children on a half-sphere around their parent (after H3).

smart.label: Smart
smart.hint: Names that are big enough on screen, the rest on hover.

done_view._comment: The 'Everything done' map: built live from every map, never stored as a file.
done_view.title: Everything done

todo_view._comment: 'Everything to do': every open task (to do and doing) from every map, around one centre you can name. Built live, never stored; only the centre's name is kept (workspace.json -> centreName).
todo_view.title: Everything to do

next_view._comment: 'Next up': what can be worked on now, from every map -- tasks under way, questions to answer, tasks nothing waits on. Built live from the plan, never stored.
next_view.title: Next up

board._comment: The Kanban board view: while a card is dragged within edge_zone_px of the board's left or right edge, it scrolls edge_scroll_px per frame.

plan._comment: Planning with conditions. Every list here is a registry: the node Plan panel, the edge toolbar, the badges and the 3D view read it. Derived state (blocked, available, not taken, critical) is computed in ui/src/core/plan.ts and never stored.

all.label: All of
all.hint: Every part is needed (the usual tree).

one.label: One of
one.hint: Alternatives: pick the path you take; the others are not taken.

atleast.label: At least
atleast.hint: A number of the parts is enough.

sequence.label: In order
sequence.hint: Each part waits for the one above it.

fs.label: Finish → start
fs.hint: Can't start until the other is done.

ss.label: Start → start
ss.hint: Can't start until the other has started.

ff.label: Finish → finish
ff.hint: Can't be finished until the other is done.

sf.label: Start → finish
sf.hint: Can't be finished until the other has started.

warn.label: Warn
warn.hint: Starting a blocked task is allowed, with a warning and Undo.

strict.label: Strict
strict.hint: A blocked task cannot be started or finished.

estimate.label: By estimates
estimate.hint: The chain with the most days of work.

steps.label: By steps
steps.hint: The chain with the most tasks.
